messages:
carmen: On the dashboard filter row, when chips wrap to a second line the tooltip anchored to the chip gets clipped and keyboard focus skips the wrapped chips. GIF attached.

yusuf: Repro at 375px width. The chip container has `overflow:hidden` and we've set tooltips to `position:absolute` inside that container, so they get cut.

leah: Could we allow overflow visible for the chip container when tooltips are open? Or render tooltips in a portal at body level so they float above. Portal preferred for consistent z-index.

omar: Portal sounds right. Also keyboard: the wrapped chips are still in DOM but visually moved; tabindex order should remain linear. If we use `display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap` the visual flow matches DOM normally but we apparently set `order` in some cases which breaks it.

carmen: We do use `order` when we force the selected chip to front; that explains it. For accessibility we should avoid changing DOM order. Use `transform: translateX` for visual reflow instead.

yusuf: CSS idea:
```css
.chips { overflow: visible; }
.chip[aria-selected] { transform: translateZ(0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus); }
``` 
Portal tooltip: render under `body` with `role=tooltip` and `data-popper` logic.

leah: Also spacing tokens: currently the row uses `space-3` which makes wrap early. Consider `space-2` for horizontal gap to reduce wrapping and allow tooltips room. But that may make dense layout.

omar: Acceptance criteria:
1) tooltips render in portal and are never clipped; 
2) tab sequence includes wrapped chips in visual order; 
3) we don't change DOM order for visual emphasis; 
4) use `space-2` token as opt-in for compact filters.

carmen: Microcopy for tooltip: show full filter label and keyboard hint: "Press Enter to toggle". Keep under ~40 chars.

yusuf: I'll open a PR with portal + token opt-in: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/4201 (WIP). Tagging eng-frontend for keyboard test.

design-bot: Reminder: add unit test covering tab order and portal behavior.

leah: I'll update Figma tokens and examples. Prefers `space-2` for compact. Marking as in-progress.
